items.problem: UWP code subscribing to Application.Current.Suspending / .Resuming (and the default UWP App template's `this.Suspending += OnSuspending;`) fails to compile in WinUI 3 with CS1061; agent lost ~9 build cycles rediscovering this.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered CS1061 (9x each); UWP MainPage.xaml.cs lines 102-103; skill-defects.json item 1.
items.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application has no Suspending/Resuming/EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground events; the skill's #lifecycle section covered activation but never the removed suspend/resume events.
items.change: Added a `\.(Suspending|Resuming)\s*\+=` adaptable pattern to unsupported-api-inventory.json (anchor: lifecycle) so Initialize-UwpMigration injects an inline `// TODO[migrate-NNN]: see PATTERNS.md#lifecycle` on the exact subscription lines; extended the #lifecycle section with a 'Suspend / Resume events are gone' subsection; and added a CS1061 entry to the 'Common build errors' section.
items.expected_effect: On re-run the agent sees an inline TODO at the Suspending/Resuming lines pointing to lifecycle guidance and removes/relocates the handlers on the first pass instead of after repeated CS1061 build failures.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run build log shows 0 CS1061 'Application does not contain a definition for Suspending/Resuming' errors; an inline TODO#lifecycle appears on the subscription lines after Initialize-UwpMigration.

items.problem: `NavigationCacheMode = NavigationCacheMode.Disabled;` (standard UWP page-template line) fails with CS0176 in WinUI 3; agent lost build cycles.
items.evidence: lessons.json errors_encountered CS0176 (11x); UWP MainPage.xaml.cs line 99; skill-defects.json item 2.
items.root_cause: Inside a Page the unqualified enum `NavigationCacheMode` is shadowed by the Page.NavigationCacheMode instance property, so the enum member is read through an instance. Not covered by the existing CS0104 namespace-collision note.
items.change: Added a CS0176 entry to the 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' section with the qualify-the-enum fix (`Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Navigation.NavigationCacheMode.Disabled`).
items.expected_effect: Agent qualifies the enum (or drops the line) on first pass instead of hitting CS0176.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-run build log shows 0 CS0176 errors on NavigationCacheMode.
